name: CUSCAPI
recent: Cuscapi 提议 RM190mil 资本削减以抵消累计亏损，相关议案将在 2026 年 12 月 18 日的特别股东大会表决。公司同时进行最多 10% 的私募配售，并有多项董事及委员会成员变动。最新季度（2026 年 9 月 30 日止）业绩由盈转亏，营收大幅下滑。
notable: 已获 Bursa Securities 批准上市最多 94,488,400 股配售股。
risks: 私募配售最多 10% 新股可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
公司涉及重大诉讼（MATERIAL LITIGATION），具体细节未在公告标题中披露。
最新季度业绩由盈转亏，营收环比下降 4.4%，同比仅增 3.1%，但净利润环比下降 28.2%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，公司营收为 RM7,550,339，净利润为 RM785,326，净利率 10.4%；营收环比下降 4.4%，净利润环比下降 28.2%；营收同比增长 3.1%，净利润同比增长 149.9%。最新季度（2026 年 9 月 30 日止）业绩由盈转亏，净亏损 RM4.47 million，营收同比暴跌 75%。

recent_en: Cuscapi has proposed a RM190 million capital reduction to offset accumulated losses and a share issuance scheme of up to 15% for employees, to be tabled at an EGM on 18 December 2026. The company is also undertaking a private placement of up to 10% and has seen several board and committee changes. Its latest quarterly results (for the period ended 30 September 2026) swung to a loss with a sharp decline in revenue.
notable_en: Proposed RM190 million capital reduction to offset accumulated losses.
Proposed establishment of a share issuance scheme (SIS) of up to 15% for eligible employees and directors.
Proposed private placement of up to 10%; Bursa Securities approved the listing of up to 94,488,400 placement shares.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
The company is involved in material litigation, with details not disclosed in the announcement titles.
The latest quarterly results swung to a loss, with revenue down 4.4% QoQ and up only 3.1% YoY, while net income fell 28.2% QoQ.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM7,550,339 and net income was RM785,326, with a net margin of 10.4%; revenue fell 4.4% QoQ and net income dropped 28.2% QoQ; revenue rose 3.1% YoY and net income surged 149.9% YoY. The latest quarter (ended 30 September 2026) swung to a net loss of RM4.47 million, with revenue plunging 75% YoY.
